info.title: Monlam AI API
info.description:
Use Monlam AI models for **Chat**, **OCR**, **Speech-to-Text**, and **Text-to-Speech**.

### Access
API key — `X-API-Key` / `x-api-key` header. Uses the organization's API key (not a user JWT). Create keys in the studio under API Keys (org OWNER/ADMIN).

Optional: `x-idempotency-key` on AI calls to avoid double-billing on retries.

Open **Authorize** in Swagger to set your API key.

tags.name: Chat
tags.description:
**Access**: API key — `X-API-Key` header.Uses the organization's API key, not a user JWT.

  OpenAI-style chat. Send the full messages history with every request so the model has conversation context.

  **Roles**:`system`, `user`, `assistant`

  **Streaming**:Use `POST /api/v1/ai/chat/stream` for Server-Sent Events (SSE).

post.description:
**Access**:API key — `X-API-Key` header.

Uses the organization's API key, not a user JWT.

Server-Sent Events with OpenAI-compatible `data:` lines.

A final `{"type":"usage",...}` event includes billing metadata.

The request body and legacy `prompt` rules are the same as the non-streaming endpoint.

**Access**

API key — `X-API-Key` header.Uses the organization's API key, not a user JWT.

Create API keys via `POST /api/api-keys` (Organization OWNER/ADMIN).Extract text from a single image using Monlam OCR.

**Form Fields**

- `file` — Required image file.
- `lang_hint` — Optional language hint, for example `bo` for Tibetan.
- `model_name` — Optional OCR model override.
- `is_async` — Determines whether the OCR request is processed asynchronously.
- `webhook_url` — Optional URL that receives the result when asynchronous processing is complete.

200.description:
OCR provider response plus `cost`, `latency_ms`,
`service_request_id`, and `status` billing metadata.

post.description:
**Access**

API key — `X-API-Key` header.

Uses the organization's API key, not a user JWT.

Create API keys via `POST /api/api-keys` (Organization OWNER/ADMIN).

Upload 2–5 images using `multipart/form-data`.

The images are stacked from top to bottom into one combined image before OCR runs.

The request is billed as one OCR page even when multiple images are uploaded.

**Form Fields**

- `page_1` — Required first image.
- `page_2` — Required second image.
- `page_3` — Optional third image.
- `page_4` — Optional fourth image.
- `page_5` — Optional fifth image.
- `lang_hint` — Optional language hint, for example `bo` for Tibetan.
- `model_name` — Optional OCR model override.

**Response**

The response includes the OCR result and `source_page_count`, which indicates
the number of source images uploaded.

200.description: OCR provider response, `source_page_count`, and billing metadata.

**Voices**

- lhasa_male
- amdo_female
- amdo_male
- kham_female
- kham_male

Synthesis response plus `cost`, `latency_ms`,

post.description:
**Access**

API key — `X-API-Key` header.

Uses the organization's API key (not a user JWT).

Streams synthesized speech as chunked **audio/wav**.

Uses the same JSON request body as the synchronous
Text-to-Speech endpoint.

**Request Fields**

- `text` — Tibetan text to synthesize.
- `voice_name` — Voice used for speech synthesis.
- `model_name` — Optional Text-to-Speech model override.

**Available Voices**

- lhasa_female
- lhasa_male
- amdo_female
- amdo_male
- kham_female
- kham_male

**Access**

Requires the `X-API-Key` header.

Uses the organization's API key (not a user JWT).

**Asynchronous Text-to-Speech**

Submit a text-to-speech synthesis request for asynchronous
processing.

The request immediately returns a job ID.

Poll `GET /api/v1/text-to-speech/jobs/{job_id}`
to retrieve the job status and synthesized audio result.

**Available Voices**

- `lhasa_female`
- `lhasa_male`
- `amdo_female`
- `amdo_male`
- `kham_female`
- `kham_male`

get.description:

Requires the `X-API-Key` header.

Retrieve the current status and result of a previously
submitted asynchronous Text-to-Speech job using its
`job_id`.
